title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 Full Length Mock Test 02 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CHSL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CHSL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Filament : Bulb :: Ink : ?
questions.explanation: Filament is an essential part of a bulb; ink is an essential part of a pen.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 3, 10, 29, 66, 127, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PLANET is coded as QMBODU, how is ORBIT coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: O to P, R to S, B to C, I to J, T to U so PSCJU.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the mother of B. C is the sister of A. D is the son of C. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: C is maternal aunt of B; D is son of C, so D is cousin of B.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Ravi walks 8 km East, turns left and walks 6 km, turns left and walks 8 km. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: He forms three sides of a rectangle; remaining displacement is 6 km North.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are papers. Conclusions: I. Some pens are papers. II. Some books are pens.
questions.explanation: All pens are books implies some books are pens. I does not necessarily follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: Cube, Sphere, Cylinder, Square
questions.explanation: Square is 2-dimensional; the others are 3-D solids.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends P,Q,R,S,T sit in a row. R is at the left end. P is not at either end. Q is immediate right of P. T is not next to R. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: R at left end. T not next to R so second is S. P not at end and Q immediate right of P so P Q occupy 3rd and 4th. T at right end. Middle is P.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which relation best represents Doctors, Females and Mothers?
options: Mothers subset of Females; Doctors intersect Females
questions.explanation: All mothers are females; some doctors may be females or mothers.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a clock shows 3:30, the mirror image time is:
questions.explanation: Mirror time = 11:60 minus given time = 8:30.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once along a diagonal and one hole is punched near the fold. Holes after unfolding:
questions.explanation: One fold produces two symmetric holes on unfolding.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: BDF, CFI, DHL, ?
questions.explanation: First +1, second +2, third +3: E, J, O.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 40, Amit ranks 12th from the top. Rank from the bottom is:
questions.explanation: From bottom = total - top rank + 1 = 40-12+1=29.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, 15 August 2025 was:
questions.explanation: Aug 2024 to Aug 2025 has 365 days = 1 odd day, so Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: First time the hands are at right angles between 3 and 4 is:
questions.explanation: Minutes = (60*H +/- 90)/5.5; first value 90/5.5 = 16 4/11 min.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All successful people work hard. Conclusions: I. All hard workers are successful. II. Some hard workers may be successful.
questions.explanation: Converse of a universal affirmative is invalid; II is a valid possibility.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A regular hexagon divided into 6 equilateral triangles most clearly embeds a:
questions.explanation: Each sector of a regular hexagon is an equilateral triangle.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Six people A B C D E F sit around a hexagon facing centre. A opposite D. B immediate right of A. C immediate left of D. Who is opposite B?
questions.explanation: Clockwise A-B-F-D-E-C gives opposite of B as E.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A standard dice shows 2,3,5 adjacent in one view. Number opposite 2 cannot be:
questions.explanation: Adjacent faces cannot be opposite, so 3 and 5 cannot be opposite 2.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: Water image is reflection over a horizontal axis.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: P >= Q = R > S <= T. Which is definitely true?
questions.explanation: P >= Q = R > S implies P > S.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: Four small upward/downward plus the original large triangle = 5.

questions.explanation: GAME uses G,A,M,E present in MANAGER.
